tolerances.note: A2.4 Intelsat: elementRange GEO plausibility (near-1.0 mean motion, near-equatorial, near-circular) PLUS a MEAN_MOTION-only check vs CelesTrak's Intelsat-11P SupGP (captured 2026-07-13, IS-21). NORAD-KEY CORRECTION: the A2.2c DRAFT said IS-21 = NORAD 38098 / COSPAR 2012-043A — that is WRONG. CelesTrak's own SupGP shows 38098 = INTELSAT 22 (IS-22), 2012-043A = IS-20 (38740), and the real IS-21 = NORAD 38749 / COSPAR 2012-045A (used here). LABELED NON-INDEPENDENT: CelesTrak's Intelsat-11P SupGP is fit from the same public Intelsat ECF/11-parameter feed. Only MEAN_MOTION is compared: at near-zero inclination (~0.006deg) and eccentricity (~0.00017), RAAN/argp/mean-anomaly are ill-conditioned (observed Δ 150deg+, physically meaningless) and are NOT compared. Nearest captured IS-21 epoch is 2026-07-09 (Δepoch ~2 days from our 2026-07-10 operator fixture) — best available in the snapshot; observed MEAN_MOTION delta 1.3e-4 (tol 8e-4). CONVERGED false = 12-point/5.5h short sample-arc artifact. A same-epoch operator+SupGP pull (A2.6) tightens this.
